title: 誤解三：agent 越複雜越好？

bullets.text: 誤解三：agent 的流程越多、系統越複雜，就一定越強。
bullets.quote: When building applications with LLMs, we recommend finding the simplest solution possible, and only increasing complexity when needed.

bullets.text: 對許多應用，單次 LLM 呼叫加上檢索與範例通常就夠用。
bullets.quote: For many applications, however, optimizing single LLM calls with retrieval and in-context examples is usually enough.

bullets.text: 成功不在於做出最精密的系統，而在於做出適合需求的系統。
bullets.quote: Success in the LLM space isn't about building the most sophisticated system. It's about building the right system for your needs.
